subsystems.name: Router / gating network
subsystems.role: Decides which experts each token should use, activating only a small subset of parameters.

subsystems.name: Expert layers
subsystems.role: Feed-forward networks that hold most of the model's parameters; only selected experts run for a given token.

subsystems.name: Sparse compute kernels
subsystems.role: Efficiently execute batched matrix multiplications only for the experts that were chosen.

subsystems.name: Memory manager
subsystems.role: Keeps expert weights in the fastest available memory and moves them when they are needed.

subsystems.name: Communication layer
subsystems.role: Moves tokens between devices when experts are spread across multiple GPUs or nodes.

subsystems.name: Serving scheduler
subsystems.role: Batches incoming requests, balances work across experts and handles overload.

subsystems.name: Quantisation and compression
subsystems.role: Reduces the precision of expert weights so more experts fit in memory and run faster.

buildSteps.title: Profile the MoE model
buildSteps.detail: Measure how often each expert is activated, where memory is spent, and where latency comes from during inference.

buildSteps.title: Design the routing policy
buildSteps.detail: Choose top-k gating, a load-balancing objective and a capacity factor so no single expert becomes a bottleneck.

buildSteps.title: Write sparse compute kernels
buildSteps.detail: Implement gather, grouped matrix multiplication and scatter operations that skip unselected experts entirely.

buildSteps.title: Lay out experts in memory
buildSteps.detail: Place expert weights across available GPUs, and add CPU or disk offloading with prefetching for experts that do not fit on the GPU.

buildSteps.title: Parallelise across devices
buildSteps.detail: Distribute experts across GPUs or nodes and implement the all-to-all communication that routes tokens to the right expert.

buildSteps.title: Quantise expert weights
buildSteps.detail: Convert expert matrices to 8-bit or 4-bit formats, calibrate accuracy and fuse dequantisation into the compute kernels.

buildSteps.title: Optimise batching
buildSteps.detail: Group tokens by expert, pad to a fixed capacity, and decide how to handle overflow tokens so latency stays predictable.

buildSteps.title: Deploy and auto-tune
buildSteps.detail: Benchmark on real traffic, then tune batch sizes, kernel configurations, routing temperature and offload thresholds.

prerequisites.why: Provides the expert layers and gating mechanism that inference optimisation builds on.
Gather/scatter and grouped GEMM kernels are needed to run only selected experts without wasting compute.
All-to-all token exchange between devices becomes the bottleneck when experts are distributed.
8-bit and 4-bit formats shrink expert weights enough to fit more of them in memory.
Lets models larger than GPU memory run, but adds latency that must be hidden by careful scheduling.

pathway.milestone: Production serving of sparse MoE models with hundreds of billions of parameters
pathway.unlocks: Lower cost per token than equivalent dense models by activating only a fraction of weights.

pathway.milestone: Better routing and load balancing that reduce token dropping and latency variance
pathway.unlocks: More predictable throughput for real-time applications.

pathway.milestone: Wider use of expert offloading to CPU memory and fast storage
pathway.unlocks: Serving models far larger than the combined GPU memory of a single node.

pathway.milestone: Dynamic expert pruning, merging and speculative routing
pathway.unlocks: Further cuts in compute and memory while preserving model quality.
